requirements: Slayer level 35 to be assigned and to kill wall beasts.
A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet must be worn to fight a wall beast safely.

methods.label: Cannon-assisted
methods.summary: Set up a Dwarf multicannon in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves to speed up the low-count task.
recommendedFor: faster completion of the short 10-20 assignment
steps: Enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves with a light source and cannon.
Deploy the Dwarf multicannon near the wall beast spawns.
Finish grabs safely with a spiny or Slayer helmet equipped throughout.

body:
# Wall beasts

Wall beasts are a Slayer level 35 task assigned by Mazchna, found only in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet is mandatory: without it a wall beast grabs you from the cave wall for up to 18 damage with no chance to retaliate. With the helmet on they are a straightforward melee target with 105 Hitpoints, Defence 16, no elemental weakness and 0 defensive bonuses. A light source is required and a Dwarf multicannon may be used.
